articles.summary: WILMINGTON, N.C., Oct. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Live Oak Bank has been named the top SBA 7(a) lender by dollar amount, according to rankings from the U.S. Small Business Administration. The SBA posted the rankings on its website . They cover the agency's 2026 fiscal year, which ended Sept. 30, 2026. "Small businesses are the backbone of the American economy, and the SBA 7(a) program is one of the most effective tools we have to help them start, grow and create jobs in their communities," said James S. (Chip) Mahan III, chairman and CEO of Live Oak Bancshares. "Being recognized as the nation's most active 7(a) lender is a tremendous honor, and it reflects our responsibility to keep capital flowing to the entrepreneurs who power local economies across the country." Live Oak approved 2,411 loans under the flagship 7(a) program this fiscal year, putting more than $2.58 billion into the hands of small business owners nationwide.
